justifications.temporal_understanding: The agent correctly interpreted all temporal expressions provided by the user throughout the conversation.
justifications.negotiation_effectiveness: The agent consistently reported unavailability and then asked the user to provide a new time or day, rather than proactively suggesting alternatives.
justifications.conversational_efficiency: The agent made multiple check_availability calls for the same day (Wednesday, June 10th) without offering different days or a wider range of times, leading to several unproductive turns.
justifications.customer_experience: The conversation felt somewhat tiring due to the agent's repetitive responses about unavailability and its failure to offer alternative slots, requiring the user to drive the negotiation.
